Initial release of the google-veo skill.

- Generate high-quality videos using Google Veo models through the inference.sh CLI.
- Supports multiple Veo models: 3.1, 3.1 Fast, 3, 3 Fast, and 2.
- Enables cinematic text-to-video generation with detailed prompt guidance.
